review_type: First independent behavior review; ML and feed labels were leads only
method: atomscan before/after; cleave facts including decoded string views; source review; rizin ARM/x64 disassembly; dnfile/dncil token-resolved CIL. No specimen executed.

samples.identification: FirmwareInstaller Java APK installer with deceptive Play attribution
evidence: install invokes sh -c pm disable com.android.vending and waits before opening the APK install session.
SessionParams sets installer package com.android.vending; supplied APK bytes are copied to openWrite, fsynced and committed.
onInstallResult contains the store-enable command; source does not itself show registration of that callback.
samples.changes: Require disabled-store installation alongside Play attribution; merge duplicate identity rule; describe the store operation without claiming successful scanner suppression.

samples.identification: ARM Linux Mirai-style HTTP flood and appliance propagation bot
evidence: 0x72b4 loads oversized POST template (Content-Length 2147483647); 0x72bc formats it, 0x736c passes buffer and length to sending helper 0x5368.
0x5368 calls socket-send wrapper 0x34c14; EAGAIN retries after polling.
0x25568 formats shell substitution inside XML language; 0x255a4 formats PUT /SDK/webLanguage and 0x255e0 submits it through 0x253a4.
0x12dfc loads ExecStart/restart unit template, 0x12e40 writes it via 0x12cf8 (open flags 0x241, mode 0644; write then close). Nearby code formats @reboot startup.
0x158dc reads /proc/self/status, 0x158f4 searches TracerPid and branches on nonzero tracer.
RxKAD exploit function 0x1f4a4 is called by 0x1d200 and contains user/network namespace setup, target-page modification and verification.
samples.obfuscation: Section-name table contains invalid UTF-8; loadable code remains disassemblable. Decoded XOR candidates were checked against raw bytes rather than presumed to be active obfuscation.
samples.changes: Add country-configuration command-substitution detection; separate botkill naming and startup/path references from inferred objectives; remove generic template-only hostile persistence.

samples.identification: Damaged native Windows PE containing an XWorm managed RAT and 7-Zip
evidence: Embedded managed client begins at file offset 0x368d0 within .rdata; appended 7zg.exe begins at overlay offset 0x5de00.
CIL method 64 (RVA 0x3218) receives length-framed socket messages, dispatches through methods 72 and 65 into handler 116.
Handler 116 decrypts messages with method 195, splits commands, executes supplied RunShell argument via Interaction.Shell, and starts/stops DDoS tasks.

Method 120 (RVA 0x4528) creates 20 threads per batch; method 161 (RVA 0x4974) connects to commanded host/port, sends POST headers promising 5235 body bytes, then sleeps 2500 ms and disposes the socket without sending a body.
Handler 116 captures the primary screen, JPEG-encodes it, serializes bytes and sends a #CAP response through method 66.
Method 127 loads supplied assembly bytes with AppDomain.Load and invokes its entry point.
Methods 194/195 encrypt/decrypt task data with Rijndael using an MD5-derived key and mode 2.
Method 163 opens CurrentUser Run and calls DeleteValue. Method 190 calls SetValue on a separate plugin storage key. No surviving linked Run-value write was established.
Native helper 0x140016f00 edits icon resources; helper 0x140016f90 calls CreateProcessW. These operations alone do not prove a malicious binder.
samples.limitations: Managed entry method and several startup methods are damaged; some outer IAT bytes are overwritten. Successful execution and effective persistence of this collected specimen are not established. Surviving malicious task handlers establish the payload purpose.
samples.changes: Remove false Run persistence and resource-editor binder inference; correct .rdata versus overlay identity; relocate 7-Zip version-resource observations.

consumer_audit: Updated exact references and local references in consumers. Path and name moves preserve matchers and effective type/platform scopes. Installer and persistence changes intentionally tighten claims; resource-editor context is notable. Legacy closed string-context predicates and attack-target endpoint fragments retain their existing placement holds.

coverage.XWorm carrier: 1 outer hostile identity plus 5 hostile embedded-client traits; 7-Zip has no hostile traits
